measured_on: the real car 2026-11-23, rosbridge 19091 over the ssh tunnel
why_this_matters: the arm status stream is 2 Hz by construction (arm_node.py:99, 0.5 s timer). Anything the recorder captures below that is a gap in the training data, not a property of the robot.
conclusion: server-side throttling recovers most of the nominal 2 Hz state rate while keeping 86-94% of samples paired inside 50 ms; leaving the images unthrottled pairs every sample but drops the state stream to about 1.7 Hz because decoding 16 frames a second starves the loop. Default is 100 ms.
